How to play Mail Myself to You

The class sings the song while a mail carrier listens. A great singer gets an envelope with a rhythm inside, then claps and says it. The box at the bottom of the screen walks you through every step.

    Before you start

    Bring out the class mailbox. The sub plan envelopes are already inside.

    When you finish

      All the mail is delivered!

      How to play Mail Myself to You

        When you finish

          1

          Syllable timing (teacher only)

          Click Start. As each syllable is sung, click Tap or press the space bar. When the last syllable is tapped, the new times show in the box below and the bouncing ball uses them right away. Click Try it in the game to check, or Copy and paste the box over SYLLABLE_TIMES in the file.
